title: Gold Rate Today August 6: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices in India rose today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also increased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in India today were ₹14,270 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹290) and ₹1,14,160 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹2,320).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,270 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹290) and ₹1,14,160 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹2,230).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,984 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹305) and ₹1,19,872 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹2,440).
